process_issues.description: Every Bash invocation failed before executing: the bubblewrap sandbox died with 'apply-seccomp: write /proc/self/setgroups (nested userns is capability-restricted; caller must provide CAP_SYS_ADMIN): Permission denied'. Even `git rev-parse HEAD`, `git diff --stat <merge_base>..HEAD`, and `gh pr view 225` failed. Without them the orchestrator could not read the PR diff, file list, intent, or head SHA, and could not run the freshness assertion. Reviewer subagents use the same sandboxed Bash, so they would have had no diff either.

No reviewers were spawned because the change could not be determined (see the platform issue). PR #225 was NOT reviewed. This record must not be read as a clean review. Re-run once the runner's sandbox can create user namespaces, or run with the sandbox configured to work on this runner.

incomplete_reason: Not reviewed: no reviewer was spawned; re-run
